 Monday BP: World Series Game 3
 Game 3 of the World Series takes place tonight! Who are Giants fans rooting for?
 by Sami Higgins Oct 26, 2026, 12:00 PM UTC Facebook 
 Link 
 Good morning, baseball fans!
 The 2026 MLB Playoffs continue tonight with Game 3 of the World Series between the visiting Milwaukee Brewers and the Tampa Bay Rays. Tonight’s game will start at 5:00 p.m. PT, airing on Fox/Fox One, with national radio coverage available on ESPN Radio.
 As usual, this is being written in the past, so I don’t yet know who has won the previous two games. Additionally, neither team has announced a starting pitcher for tonight’s game as of the time this is being written. I’ll try to hop in on Monday and add more information.
 Who are you rooting for in Game 3?
